dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible across the mid-lateral and posterior sections. These feature thin, high-contrast dark perimeters with irregular, slightly jagged geometries that transition abruptly into lighter grey internal areas.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid dark pixel clusters is localized in the spaces between macro-annuli, particularly along the lower flank; these clusters lack internal gradients and appear as asymmetrical, low-intensity spots.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest annuli on the mid-lateral flank form an obtuse triangle, while a series of smaller annuli on the lower posterior region form a nearly linear chain of four points.
